method: Actual GLTFLoader geometry and unchanged production GSAP controller. Every prop vertex is evaluated in original room coordinates, removing only the external uniform room reveal. Downward ray/triangle hits on unchanged reference floor, desk, coffee table, rug or static architecture confirm selected support crossings. Whole-scene AABB overlap is not treated as collision.
limitations: Reference support is in its final pose: a delayed or still-growing support is reported separately by choreography checks.
Footprint escape alone is a trajectory risk, not a triangle collision verdict.
This low-vertex witness scan is not exhaustive triangle/triangle intersection testing.

This intermediate baseline already includes hardware binding in its animated scene; the pre-binding main_display reference box is not comparable. That record is excluded from verified collision counts. Raw data is retained for provenance.

handoffAndExterior.method: Real GLTFLoader + production controller and GSAP; source triangle edge segments intersect target triangles using BVH broadphase, strict interior segment hits. Sparse source triangle sampling: terminal stride2, exterior stride7; coordinates are world units. Does not prove absence of unsampled collisions.
